description: Codex-exec probes for Mathformer generative and hybrid skill families.

probes.prompt: Read skills/control/mathformer-generative-workflow-coordinator/SKILL.md and skills/control/mathformer-workflow-router/SKILL.md. Do not edit files. A user asks: `Set up Mathformer, formalize a paper theory in Lean, and publish the result.` The user has authorized local setup and formalization but has not authorized publication. Return compact JSON with keys skill, verdict, evidence, regression. The evidence must decompose the goal, resolve named workflows through the deterministic router, preserve ordering, and block publication pending explicit authorization.

Read skills/autoformalization/autoformalization-agentc/SKILL.md. Do not edit files. A user asks the legacy AgentC wrapper to change the Lean semantic-preservation prompt. Return compact JSON with keys skill, verdict, evidence, regression. The verdict should route canonical prompt edits to the specialized owner while preserving AgentC compatibility.

Read skills/autoformalization/autoformalization-workflow-orchestrator/SKILL.md and skills/SKILL_HOOKS.yaml. Do not edit files. For an end-to-end run with LaTeX expansion, review, mathlib mapping, initial drafting, Lean execution, and refinement, return compact JSON with keys skill, verdict, evidence, regression. The evidence must state that expansion review and mathlib alignment happen before drafting, and Lean execution happens after initial output.

Return compact JSON with keys skill, verdict, evidence, regression. The verdict must block initial drafting, route to reuse or candidate verification, and mention that web search over official mathlib sources is required before claiming absence.

Read skills/latex-textbook/latex-expansion-binding-reviewer/SKILL.md. Do not edit files. Evaluate this expansion: `Theorem: For every x in A, y > x. Proof: Let x in A. Since y is positive, y > x.` Return compact JSON with keys skill, verdict, evidence, regression. The verdict must be fail if any binder or domain is missing.
